findings.title: Runbook plain_password count off by one
findings.detail: Section 6 states `SELECT COUNT(*) FROM users WHERE plain_password IS NOT NULL; -- 29 (28 plaintext users + owner)`. The owner-mobile row (legacy id 5, a plaintext user) is skipped, so the correct value is 28 (27 imported customers + seeded owner). verification.md already corrected this to 28; update the runbook SELECT comment to match so an operator does not read a correct import as a failure.

findings.title: delivery_address not cleared on re-import when both deliveryAddress and customer are absent
findings.detail: In importOrders, `delivery_address: deliveryAddress ?? undefined` means the column is left untouched on the upsert UPDATE branch when both the order's deliveryAddress and customer are missing. All 16 current orders carry a customer object, so this never fires today; it is a latent edge, not a current bug. Use null instead of undefined if re-imports should be able to clear the field.
